name: ProductLockup
description: v2 — Adobe product identity unit: app icon(s) + product name label + optional caret. Used in ElasticCard headers, RouterNavItem tiles, and anywhere a product name with icon is needed. The v1 Context axis (on-light/on-dark) is retired: theme flows from variable modes (:root[data-theme]); per-instance surface treatment is the Style axis.

props.name: productName
props.description: Alias for label. Takes precedence when set.

props.name: secondApp
props.description: App slug for the optional second icon

props.name: styleVariant
props.description: label = content/label ink · eyebrow = content/eyebrow ink + eyebrow ramp · knockout = always-white for dark/media surfaces · inverse = flips opposite the theme

props.name: context
props.description: DEPRECATED v1 alias — "on-dark" maps to styleVariant "knockout" when styleVariant is unset. Remove usages; theme comes from variable modes.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: auto = md (24px, Figma v2 default). Or explicit AppIcon size: xs/sm/md/lg

props.name: caret
props.description: Custom caret template. null = no caret.

notes: The AppIcon(s) inside are aria-hidden by default — the visible label provides the accessible name.
When used as a link or button header, the parent element should supply the accessible name for the interactive region.
